## Verdict: PASS

Every failing line of the round is confirmed with this seat's own evidence: fixed and pinned, marked, confirmed DONE,
left DEFERRED or REPORTED with its stated reason. Every gate is green. RELATED@1000 gave 1 950 / 1 950, with no J176
bench red in the set. The refusal census did not rise: 321 → 321, and green rose 1 289 → 1 299. 14 of 18 targeted
mutants were killed. The 4 survivors are judged below. Two are equivalent (C4, J6). Two are unpinned clauses of a guard,
which no honest draw reaches (J1, J4); they are hardening notes, not blockers. No new blocker was found.

the tree.

| | draws | green | refusals | by code |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before | 1 299 | 1 289 (`limit/cap-move-halvings` 10 failing, KI-2) | 321 | E_DEGENERATE 113, E_NOT_TWO_CROSSINGS 88, E_INVARIANT 40, E_BELOW_MIN_WIDTH 20, threw 20, E_BELOW_MIN_EDGE 10, E_WORK_LIMIT 10, E_BELOW_MIN_AREA 10, E_NON_CONVEX 10 |
| after | 1 299 | 1 299 | 321 | identical, by code and by case |
